articles.summary: Peoples Financial Services Corp. ("PFIS" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: PFIS), the bank holding company for Peoples Security Bank and Trust Company (the "Bank"), announced today that Scott Campagna has joined the organization as Executive Vice President, Chief Information Officer. Scott Campagna has joined Peoples Security Bank Trust as Executive Vice President, Chief Information Officer Campagna succeeds Susan Hubble, who will serve as Senior Executive Advisor to support the leadership transition until her retirement in April 2027, after more than 27 years with the Bank. Hubble joined the Bank in November 1999 as Systems Administrator and later served in senior information technology officer roles before becoming Chief Information Officer in December 2019. The Bank extends its sincere thanks to Susan for her service and wishes her all the best in retirement. articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Peoples Financial Services Corp. (“Peoples”) (NASDAQ: PFIS) declared a fourth quarter cash dividend of $0.6250 per share. The dividend is payable December 15, 2026 to shareholders of record November 30, 2026. Peoples Financial Services Corp. is the bank holding company of Peoples Security Bank and Trust Company, an independent community bank serving its retail and commercial customers through 40 full-service community banking offices located within the Allegheny, Bucks, Lackawanna, Lancaster, Lebanon, Lehigh, Luzerne, Monroe, Montgomery, Northampton, Susquehanna, Wayne, and Wyoming Counties in Pennsylvania, Middlesex County in New Jersey and Broome County in New York. Each office, interdependent with the community, offers a comprehensive array of financial products and services to individuals, businesses, not-for-profit organizations and government entities. People's business philosophy includes offering direct access to senior management and other officers
articles.title: PEOPLES FINANCIAL SERVICES CORP. Declares Fourth Quarter 2026 Dividend

(“Peoples” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: PFIS), the bank holding company for Peoples Security Bank and Trust Company (the “Bank”), today reported unaudited financial results at and for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Peoples reported net income of $19.1 million, or $1.90 per diluted share for the three months ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $3.9 million compared to net income of $15.2 million, or $1.51 per diluted share for the three months ended September 30, 2025.
